propositions: The except spine (lines 555-629 in runner.py) must be extracted into a standalone interpret_failure() function in structured_run.py while preserving the three-arm exception handling order: UsageLimitExceeded, LLMError, then broad Exception.

Sampling parameter rejection must be reclassified as LLMConfigError before the broad Exception arm runs; arm ordering prevents silent misclassification as provider outage, validated by type(err) is LLMConfigError assertions not isinstance checks.

The function must preserve raised exception types unchanged for all three arms so existing except LLMUnavailableError callers remain unbroken, while attaching disposition metadata via .outcome attribute.
Eight monkeypatch targets in the test suite must be verified not to lie in the except spine; if any moved, repointing must occur in the same commit with explicit justification.
The extracted code must reduce runner.py's LOC below 700-line headroom while remaining under the parent commit's baseline, with before/after LOC recorded in the commit message.
